disposition_reason: Preprint (Research Square, not peer reviewed) printing per-location means of eight metals in honey and trapped bee pollen from 40 colonies at eight Konya sites.

study.design: Field placement study: five colonies at each of four urban-fringe and four rural sites; honey, pollen and bees analysed
study.origin: Konya province, Turkey; eight multifloral locations L1 to L8
study.market: produced in study hives, not purchased

period.as_reported: 2018; pollen trapped May and June 2018; honey harvested 15 July to 15 August 2018

study.method: ICP-AES (axial) after HNO3/H2O2 microwave digestion of 0.2 g
study.qa: One blank and one CRM (NIST SRM 1547 peach leaves) per 40-vessel run; recoveries not reported

unresolved: Preprint: not peer reviewed (Research Square v1, posted 1 March 2022).
Honey basis not stated (analysed as harvested); pollen was oven-dried at 70 °C before analysis, so pollen is dry weight.
Whole-bee results (Table 3) are biological samples and are not extracted.
Text statement of honey maxima (e.g. 'L1, 1,270 mg/kg' for Fe) mislabels the Mn value of Table 1; tables used as printed.
LOD/LOQ and CRM recoveries are not reported.
The same 2018 Konya colonies (L1 to L4) are re-reported as pooled urban means in Ilhan et al. 2023 (Bee Studies 15(2):49-59).
